hints: Use the perimeter of the sector formula $2r + \text{Arc } AB = 20$ with $\text{Arc } AB = 8$ to find the radius $r = 6\text{ cm}$.
Calculate chord length $AB = 2r\sin(\theta/2)$ and add the arc length $8\text{ cm}$.
walkthrough:
Find the radius $r$ using the perimeter of the sector:
$$\text{Perimeter} = 2r + \text{Arc } AB = 20 \implies 2r + 8 = 20 \implies 2r = 12 \implies r = 6\text{ cm}$$

Determine angle $\theta = \angle AOB$ in radians using the arc length formula $s = r\theta$:
$$\theta = \frac{s}{r} = \frac{8}{6} = \frac{4}{3}\text{ radians} \approx 1.3333\text{ rad}$$

Calculate the length of the straight chord $AB$ using trigonometry (or the cosine rule):
$$\text{Chord } AB = 2r\sin\left(\frac{\theta}{2}\right) = 2(6)\sin\left(\frac{2}{3}\right) = 12\sin(0.6667) \approx 7.420\text{ cm}$$

Sum the chord length and the arc length to find the perimeter of the shaded segment:
$$\text{Perimeter} = \text{Chord } AB + \text{Arc } AB = 7.420 + 8 = 15.420 \approx 15.4\text{ cm}$$

hints: Calculate the area of sector $OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \theta$.
Calculate the area of triangle $\triangle OAB = \frac{1}{2} r^2 \sin\theta$.
Subtract the triangle area from the sector area to find the segment area.
walkthrough:
Calculate the area of sector $OAB$ with $r = 6\text{ cm}$ and $\theta = \frac{4}{3}\text{ rad}$:
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } OAB) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(6^2)\left(\frac{4}{3}\right) = 18 \times \frac{4}{3} = 24\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of the isosceles triangle $\triangle OAB$:
$$\text{Area}(\triangle OAB) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}(6^2)\sin\left(\frac{4}{3}\right) = 18\sin(1.3333) \approx 17.495\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the triangle area from the sector area to obtain the shaded segment area:
$$\text{Area}(\text{segment}) = 24 - 17.495 = 6.505 \approx 6.51\text{ cm}^2$$
